title: Basic Mechanics of Laminated Composite Plates
citation: Nettles, A. T.: Basic Mechanics of Laminated Composite Plates. NASA Reference Publication 1351, NASA Marshall Space Flight Center, October 1994.

reuse.basis: NTRS record metadata: distribution PUBLIC; copyright determination GOV_PUBLIC_USE_PERMITTED (U.S. Government work).

files.note: cited pages only: the PDF's embedded OCR text layer, pypdf 6.19.0, unmodified

used: CLT equations (reduced stiffness eq. 10, transformation eq. 22, A/B/D eqs. 53/54/56, symmetric-laminate engineering constants sec. V.B) implemented in domains/uav_materials/clt.py; the machine-readable numbers of examples 2 and 9 (lamina properties p.82; Q, Qbar(45), A and B values pp.46, 84) as validation data in tests.
not_used: Pages whose equations and example inputs exist only as images (e.g. example 1); hygrothermal and stress-analysis sections.
caveats: The source rounds nu21 to 0.02; its printed Q11 follows from that rounding. The documentation page states 'Strength of laminated composites is not covered'.
